Autoscaling: Do You Actually Need It? A Decision Guide

Quick thread 🧵
Autoscaling adds servers when a metric like CPU crosses a threshold and removes them when load falls, so capacity tracks real traffic.
It's a genuine win for spiky, unpredictable load.
But most apps have steady traffic and do fine on one right-sized server, plus maybe a node or two behind a load balancer.
And it only works if your app is stateless, so that's the real first job.
